description: MUMmer 3.23 show-aligns: the alignments between one reference record and one query record of a nucmer delta file drawn as three rows (reference, query, a ^ under every difference; an indel is a . in the other row) in blocks of the screen width (-w, default 60; 11 or less is replaced with a warning), each row prefixed with the 1-based forward-strand position of its first base; '-- BEGIN alignment [ +1 sR - eR | +1 sQ - eQ ]' / END lines frame every alignment (a reverse-strand alignment shows -1). The alignments are in file order unless sortByReference (-r) / sortByQuery (-q). The program reads the sequences from the FASTA files named in the delta header: pass their text. A promer (amino-acid) delta file is drawn in amino acids: the frames are translated, the middle row shows the identical residue or + for a similar one under the matrix of matrixType (-x: 1 = BLOSUM 45, 2 = BLOSUM 62 default, 3 = BLOSUM 80; another value is replaced with a warning), the row order is reference, match row, query. Byte for byte equal to the installed show-aligns on 300 nucmer and 250 + promer runs.

referenceFasta.description: Reference FASTA text (the file named in the delta header).

queryFasta.description: Query FASTA text (the file named in the delta header).

sortByQuery.description: -q: sort the alignments by the query start (default false).

sortByReference.description: -r: sort the alignments by the reference start (default false).

matrixType.description: -x: matrix of a promer alignment, 1 = BLOSUM 45, 2 = BLOSUM 62 (default), 3 = BLOSUM 80; only decides which differences are shown as similar (+).

text.description: What show-aligns writes to standard output.

messages.description: What it writes to standard error (warnings).

errors.message: Delta file text cannot be null or empty
